name: uipath-coded-apps
description: Create, pack, publish, and deploy UiPath Coded Apps end-to-end. Guided UiPath sign-in, no commands to run, returns the live app URL.

client_id.title: UiPath App ID (Client ID)
client_id.description: App ID of a Confidential External Application in UiPath (Admin → External Applications). Used for non-interactive sign-in.

client_secret.title: UiPath App Secret (Client Secret)
client_secret.description: App Secret for the same External Application. Stored securely and never shown in chat.

tenant_name.title: Tenant
tenant_name.description: UiPath tenant name to deploy into (e.g. DefaultTenant).

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Which UiPath environment to sign in to: cloud, staging, or alpha.
